title: Sprint launch mutates tracker state before branch setup can fail
description: Evidence: apps/cli/src/commands/sprint.ts creates the sprint and dependency before attachSprintLaunchBranch runs git branch setup, and failed git switch throws afterward. Impact: a dirty/conflicted checkout can leave created/orphaned sprint state after a failed launch.
acceptanceCriteria: sprint launch preflights branch setup before state mutation or rolls back/marks failed launch state atomically, with a git-failure regression.
